Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game where India takes a 1-0 lead and will be looking to wrap up the series in the next game while Bangladesh will be hoping to level it. The 2nd T20I will be played on 9th October, Wednesday in New Delhi at the iconic Arun Jaitley Stadium. It will start at 1.30 pm GMT, but as you know, you can always join us early for all the build-up to the match. Until then, cheers and goodbye!

Arshdeep Singh is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant bowling spell. He says that there was a breeze going around from the end he was bowling. Adds that he did not get his first wicket the way he wanted but was happy with it anyway. Mentions that he makes minor changes like with his wrists or fingers to bring in the variations. Says that the young bowlers have done well especially Mayank Yadav who had a good debut. Ends by saying that, this format is all about adapting to situations, conditions, and ground dimensions.

Suryakumar Yadav, the victorious skipper of India says they just tried to back their skills and tried to walk the talk. Mentions it was great how the guys showed character and selflessness. On being asked about the two debutants, Mayank and Nitish, he appreciates them and says they are interesting players and is looking forward to watching them do well in future games. On being asked about so many players to choose from, he jokingly says it is a good headache to have many options at your disposal when you are on the field. Concludes by saying there's always room to learn and improve in every game.

Najmul Hossain Shanto, the captain of Bangladesh says that they did not start well. Adds that in T20s it is important to play well in the Powerplay but they didn't. Mentions that the plan was to bat positively but they also need to adjust according to the situation. Tells that they need to focus on strike rotation and not only on hitting boundaries. Says that they scored 95-odd runs in 14 overs but lost too many wickets. Ends by saying that it is difficult for the bowlers to defend such a low score on a wicket like this, but still Rishad Hossain bowled well and Fizz delivered a couple of decent overs.
Presentation Time...

Varun Chakaravarthy is up for a quick chat. He says it feels like a rebirth for him to be back in the blues after 3 long years.  Adds he just wanted to stick to the process, and that's what he tried to do in the Indian T20 League earlier this year. Adds he doesn't want to think and express too much. Mentions he played a few leagues and got to learn a lot in the TNPL alongside Ravichandran Ashwin, and it was a good preparation for him for this series. Says once you're not in the Indian team, people write you off and you just need to keep doing the job sincerely.

Earlier in the game, Bangladesh posted a below-par total with only Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mehidy Hasan crossing the 20-run mark. Arshdeep Singh and Varun Chakaravarthy were the pick of the bowlers for India with three wickets each while debutant, Mayank Yadav also performed well and got one. Hardik Pandya and Washington Sundar also chipped in with one each as well. It was a real all-round performance from the World T20 champions and the batters also made the chase look like a cakewalk.

Not much to talk about the bowling of Bangladesh and it was not helped by the fact that their batters did not show up for this game. They were put under pressure early on from the Indian openers and never seemed to recover from that. Mehidy Hasan and Mustafizur Rahman were the ones with a wicket to their name while the other one was a run out. However, there were a few positives, mainly the spinners. Rishad Hossain did not get a wicket but bowled really well and Shoriful Islam was also economical in his two overs and this is something they can build on in the upcoming games.

The target for India was not a big one, but the way they executed the chase was excellent. The positive intent was visible right from the start when the two openers took on the attack. Abhishek Sharma fell to an unfortunate run out but not before playing a fiery cameo. It was actually selfless batting from all the players and no one was going for personal milestone. Sanju Samson failed to convert his start again but showed his class in his knock of 29 off 19. SKY was exceptional and displayed a show of brilliant whips and flicks which also ultimately proved to be his downfall. With not much required to chase, Hardik Pandya and Nitish Kumar Reddy joined hands and made sure to finish the job. Reddy was the second fiddle while Pandya stayed unbeaten on 39 off just 16 balls finishing things off with little more than 8 overs to spare.

DOMINANCE FROM INDIA! The first T20I in this new stadium in Gwalior and the Men in Blue were simply brilliant with both bat and bowl providing an incredible experience for the packed crowd. The hosts take the early lead in the series with Bangladesh having their task cut out now.

SIX! HARDIK PANDYA FINISHES OFF IN STYLE FOR INDIA! Banged in short and on the top of the stumps, Hardik Pandya stands tall, backs away, swings hard, and slaps the pull rows behind the deep mid-wicket fence for a huge six. Hardik kills the game with 49 balls remaining and 7 wickets in hand.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.5: Taskin Ahmed to Hardik Pandya, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! The ball's gone and so has the bat! Hard length outside off. Hardik cuts it hard and loses the grip of the bat. However, he connects it off the middle and the ball goes racing away to the deep backward point fence for a boundary while the bat flies to the square leg region. It's all happening here!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.4: Taskin Ahmed to Hardik Pandya, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Easy peasy! Into the single figures now! Short and on off, Hardik Pandya arches back, ramps it over the keeper's head for a boundary. He doesn't even look at the ball as it dribbles away into the fence. Quite a raw expression from Pandya.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.3: Taskin Ahmed to Hardik Pandya, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Much fuller, on middle, Nitish Kumar Reddy flicks it with his wrists to deep square leg for another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.2: Taskin Ahmed to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Taskin comes back into the attack, bowls a toe-crushing yorker on the pads, and bends Hardik Pandya who tries to flick it away. It goes off Pandya's boot to short fine for a leg bye.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.1: Taskin Ahmed to Hardik Pandya, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Doesn't get hold of it, does Hardik. Nice and full, on off, Hardik Pandya swings hard at it to go over the long on region but gets it off the inner half for a single. India just 12 runs away from the win.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.6: Rishad Hossain to Hardik Pandya, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, full and flat, Hardik Pandya pushes it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.5: Rishad Hossain to Hardik Pandya, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! MURDERED! Rishad Hossain drags his length, keeps it on off, Hardik Pandya gets a good bounce on his waist height, rocks back by using the depth of the crease and slashes it hard and over covers with a short-arm jab for a six. That was hit with brute force by Hardik.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.4: Rishad Hossain to Hardik Pandya, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Rishad hurries Hardik on this length ball, that skids through the surface. Hardik Pandya goes for a cut shot but gets a thick outside edge and Mehidy Hasan doesn't collect the ball properly. It lands just near him.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.3: Rishad Hossain to Hardik Pandya, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A bit of a rusty shot there by Hardik! Tossed up, around off, Hardik Pandya swings hard and slices it over point for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.2: Rishad Hossain to Hardik Pandya, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Halt! Litton Das has taken a nasty blow on his fingers trying to collect the ball. The physio is in and he will be applying some magic spray to relieve the pain. We are good to continue now.

Slow through the air, nice and full, outside off, Nitish Kumar Reddy pushes it to covers and steals a single. A wayward throw comes to the left of the keeper and Das couldn't collect it properly. The ball deflects off his gloves and rolls to the short fine but there is a backup to prevent any other run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.1: Rishad Hossain to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Pandya in a hurry to finish things off! Not an ideal length with no fielders in the deep. Full and just outside off, Hardik Pandya knows the fielders are inside the ring and just lofts it over covers and mid off for a boundary. India need 22 more to win in 60 balls.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.6: Mustafizur Rahman to Hardik Pandya, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks! There seemed to be some issue with Hardik Pandya and the umpires have decided to call for drinks. India are absolutely cruising along in the chase and the question is how quickly can they get the job done. The intent have been clear from every batter and it is to attack no matter what. Bangladesh have tried their best but defending such a score against this India side was never going to be easy.
Across off on a hard length, Nitish Kumar Reddy pushes it with firm hands past cover for another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.5: Mustafizur Rahman to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a good length, on off, Hardik Pandya swooshes hard at it on the front foot, ends up slicing it over cover-point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.4: Mustafizur Rahman to Hardik Pandya, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Gee, that's some shot! 100 up for India in double-quick time! Half-tracker on the top of the middle, Hardik Pandya arches back and taps the ball over backward point for a boundary. India motoring away comfortably.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.3: Mustafizur Rahman to Hardik Pandya, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, that skidded through like a bullet! Length ball, outside leg, Nitish Kumar Reddy is hurried by the pace to pull it away but gets it off the thigh pads instead. The ball rolls to the off side and they cross over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.2: Mustafizur Rahman to Nitish Kumar Reddy, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length, across off, Hardik Pandya slices it over covers for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.1: Mustafizur Rahman to Hardik Pandya, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! INTO THE CROWD! First six for Nitish! Tossed up, a genuine half-volley on offer, Nitish Kumar Reddy walks down, gets his bat under the ball, middles it and tonks it over the long on fence for a huge six. India need 34 off 66 now.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.6: Rishad Hossain to Nitish Kumar Reddy, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, around off on a fuller length, Hardik Pandya brings out the broom and sweeps it to bisect the deep mid-wicket region but Towhid Hridoy there does an exceptional work. He runs to his right and intercepts the ball cleanly with a timely dive. Keeps it to just a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.5: Rishad Hossain to Hardik Pandya, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, at off, punched down to long off for one by Nitish.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.4: Rishad Hossain to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A proper leg spinner, just holding on the surface a bit, on a good length, Nitish Kumar Reddy negotiates well and taps it off the back foot to the pitch.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.3: Rishad Hossain to Nitish Kumar Reddy, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Sliding on middle, full in length, Hardik Pandya works it to cover-point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.2: Rishad Hossain to Hardik Pandya, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: In front of the stumps, eased off the back foot to mid on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.1: Rishad Hossain to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Hardik gets off the mark in fine fashion there. Overpitched at the stumps, in the slot of Hardik, thumps it away with sheer power through deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.6: Mehidy Hasan to Hardik Pandya, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Hardik Pandya is the next man in.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Mehidy Hasan strikes in his very first over and India are 3 down now. Mehidy Hasan bowls it full and flat and keeps the line of attack on the middle and leg stump. Sanju Samson clears his front foot to get some width and goes through the hoick across the line, but it is too close to the body and gets no power and timing at all. Goes off the inner half of the bat and straight towards Rishad Hossain at deep mid-wicket. Sanju Samson straightaway knew that he was in trouble after the point of contact. He departs for a decent 29 off 19!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishad Hossain b Mehidy Hasan
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.5: Mehidy Hasan to Sanju Samson, OUT! c Rishad Hossain b Mehidy Hasan.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on middle, Nitish Kumar Reddy walks down the track and drives it to long on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.4: Mehidy Hasan to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: 'Two' is the call from Sanju and they will get it! Length on the pads, Nitish Kumar Reddy glances it off the hips to wide of short fine and gets a couple.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.3: Mehidy Hasan to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Nice and full, pushed through on middle, Nitish Kumar Reddy leans on and eases it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.2: Mehidy Hasan to Nitish Kumar Reddy, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Mehidy begins his spell now, over the stumps, too full, flat on leg, pushed to short mid-wicket by Nitish.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.1: Mehidy Hasan to Nitish Kumar Reddy, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! How good is that shot from Samson? He spoils an otherwise quiet over from Rishad. Lands it on the short of a good length, in front of the sticks does Rishad, Sanju Samson goes across the leg stump and creates room for himself before crisply cutting it in front of the square for a boundary at deep covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.6: Rishad Hossain to Sanju Samson, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Looped up, around off, full in length, Nitish Kumar Reddy gets on the front foot and drills it down the ground with the spin to long off for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.5: Rishad Hossain to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, trying to be extra innovative there! Tossed up, outside off, turning away a tad, Nitish Kumar Reddy goes for a switch hit but gloves it to the slip on a bounce.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Rishad Hossain to Nitish Kumar Reddy, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A slider, on middle and leg, on a nagging length, Sanju Samson backs away to create room, slashes hard to long off for an easy single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Rishad Hossain to Sanju Samson, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Dragged length, on the top of off, Samson gets on the back foot and punches it to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Rishad Hossain to Sanju Samson, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A leggie, full and outside off, turns away a shade, Samson gets on the front foot to push it away but plays inside the line and gets beaten. Rishad starts right on money.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Rishad Hossain to Sanju Samson, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: We will see spin for the first time in this chase as Rishad Hossain comes into the attack.

Too full, and around off, Sanju Samson pushes it with a straight bat face to piece the mid off region but the fielder there does well and compels Samson to hurry to the other end. A direct hit is scored but Sanju is well home in time by then.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Mustafizur Rahman to Sanju Samson, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nonchalant! Pace and bounce on a length, on the leg stump line, Sanju Samson rises on the bounce, gets on his toes and glances it beautifully through deep mid-wicket for a boundary. He moves into his 20s now.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Mustafizur Rahman to Sanju Samson, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: On off, on a good length, pushed to wide of mid off for one. First runs for Nitish in T20Is.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Mustafizur Rahman to Nitish Kumar Reddy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Nitish Kumar Reddy comes out to the middle on his debut.

OUT! TAKEN! The Fizz redeems himself with a wicket! India are two down now with SKY departing on 29 off just 14. Mustafizur Rahman continues to go fuller in length, and on the leg stump line, Suryakumar Yadav looks to wrist it over deep square leg but doesn't get the elevation on it. He times it really well but unfortunately, it goes straight into the hands of Jaker Ali stationed at deep square leg. The ball goes down the throat and Jaker doesn't have to move an inch from his position.
Commentary.Howout: c Jaker Ali b Mustafizur Rahman
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Mustafizur Rahman to Suryakumar Yadav, OUT! c Jaker Ali b Mustafizur Rahman.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! GWALIOR HAS BEEN TREATED WITH SOME EXQUISITE SHOTS FROM SKY ALREADY! The Fizz misfires and lands a half-volley on leg, rolls his fingers as well and takes all the pace off, Suryakumar Yadav waits for it to arrive. Suryakumar Yadav's hands come through beautifully, gets his bat underneath the ball and lofts it over long on for a six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Mustafizur Rahman to Suryakumar Yadav, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Follows the batter and bowls it closer to the body as Samson moves across to the leg side, on a good length, this is tucked away with soft hands to wide of mid on for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Mustafizur Rahman to Sanju Samson, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Change? No, Mustafizur Rahman to continue.

SIX! You just cannot bowl there to Sky! Taskin Ahmed misses his mark again and bowls this right in the slot, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav steps across, picks it up and whips it ten rows back over the deep square leg fence for another biggie. 14 runs off the over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Taskin Ahmed to Suryakumar Yadav, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav nudges it to the leg side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Taskin Ahmed to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! 50 UP FOR INDIA! Taskin Ahmed goes for the yorker but just misses it and bowls a low full toss, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav reacts well to it and flicks it away with amazing timing. The ball zips through square leg and beats the dive of the fielder in the deep as well to go for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Taskin Ahmed to Suryakumar Yadav, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Third time lucky! This is pitched up and around middle, pace on this time, Suryakumar Yadav gets low across and executes the whip perfectly over short fine for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Taskin Ahmed to Suryakumar Yadav, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss again! Slower one now, good length and on off, Suryakumar Yadav once again looks for his favourite flick shot but goes through it early and misses again, gets a bottom edge in front of the bowler on the bounce.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Taskin Ahmed to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and around off, Suryakumar Yadav goes down across to whip it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Taskin Ahmed to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on middle, slower again, Sanju Samson gets squared up as the ball goes of the leading edge along the ground towards point. 12 runs off the over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Mustafizur Rahman to Sanju Samson, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Sanju Samson pats it down to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Mustafizur Rahman to Sanju Samson, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up but well outside off, Sanju Samson leaves it alone. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Mustafizur Rahman to Sanju Samson, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Classy from Sanju Samson! Full and on off, Sanju Samson stays in his crease, keeps a steady head and drives it away beautifully past mid off for a boundary. He is looking in great touch here, but needs to convert this start.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Mustafizur Rahman to Sanju Samson, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav works it wide of mid on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Mustafizur Rahman to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good comeback from Fizz! He lands this on a hard length and around off, gets some extra bounce on this one, Suryakumar Yadav tries to cut it but it keeps shooting up and zips past the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Mustafizur Rahman to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! We don't have to wait long for the SKY whipper! Mustafizur Rahman starts with an off-pace delivery, full and around middle, Suryakumar Yadav picks it up, steps across and using his wrists flicks it nonchalantly over the deep square leg fence for a biggie. Fizz greeted with a six just like Taskin!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Mustafizur Rahman to Suryakumar Yadav, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: With a long batting still to come, Bangladesh need a couple of more quick wickets to get in a close contest here.
Back of a length and on off, Sanju Samson steers it towards point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Shoriful Islam to Sanju Samson, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Fine shot! Shoriful Islam bowls this full and on off, rolls his wrists to take pace off. Sanju Samson picks it up, waits for it and takes the aerial route to loft it over extra covers for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Shoriful Islam to Sanju Samson, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Right in the blockhole, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav clips it to mid-wicket for another run. There was some confusion again between the batters but no harm done.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Shoriful Islam to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and around off, Sanju Samson swats it to mid off for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Shoriful Islam to Sanju Samson, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched and on off, Suryakumar Yadav drills it wide of mid off for a single and gets off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Shoriful Islam to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and around off, Suryakumar Yadav pushes it towards covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Shoriful Islam to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: There was never a run there and Abhishek would be absolutely gutted with himself. Who walks in next to bat? Indian skipper, Suryakumar Yadav walks in at number 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up in the middle and that cost India dearly! On a length and on middle, Sanju Samson pats it down in front of short mid-wicket and seeing Samson gearing up with a couple of steps ahead, Abhishek Sharma sets off for the run. He is sent back by Samson but by then he is already halfway through the pitch and gets stranded. Towhid Hridoy picks up and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end with Sharma nowhere near the crease. There was never a run there. Abhishek Sharma walks back after a quick-fire 16 off 7!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Taskin Ahmed to Sanju Samson, OUT! run out (Towhid Hridoy).

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, Abhishek Sharma runs it down to third man for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Taskin Ahmed to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: EDGED AND FOUR! Slower one, good length and around leg, Abhishek Sharma backs away and looks to punch it away, but gets an inside edge past the keeper and to the fine leg fence for four more runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Taskin Ahmed to Abhishek Sharma, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on middle, Abhishek Sharma blocks it on the pitch.

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Taskin Ahmed to Abhishek Sharma, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! Abhishek Sharma greets Taskin Ahmed with a six! This is a full delivery and around off, Abhishek Sharma walks across and tonks it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Taskin Ahmed to Abhishek Sharma, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Taskin Ahmed to share the attack.

Najmul Hossain Shanto at mid off dives to his right but the ball goes wide of him and to the fence for a boundary. 10 runs off the first over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Shoriful Islam to Sanju Samson, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle, Sanju Samson stays back and blocks it out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Shoriful Islam to Sanju Samson, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Gorgeous shot! Shoriful Islam serves this full and around middle, shaping in, Sanju Samson is already stand out of his crease. He presents the full face of the and plays a lovely straight drive past the bowler for the first boundary of the chase.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Shoriful Islam to Sanju Samson, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Streaky! Short of a length and outside off, sticks to the surface a bit, Abhishek Sharma looks for the cut but gets a bottom edge wide of the stumps for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Shoriful Islam to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and around off, Abhishek Sharma stays back and dabs it to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Shoriful Islam to Abhishek Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Sanju Samson and India are underway straightaway! Shoriful Islam starts with a full delivery, on the pads, Sanju Samson flicks it away through square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Shoriful Islam to Sanju Samson, 1 run.
